summary: Incorruptible debuts at #5 on the Lit Hub-published Independent Press Top 40 Bestsellers: Nonfiction list (week ending May 31, 2026), compiled by the American Booksellers Association and the Independent Publishers Caucus from sales in hundreds of independent bookstores nationwide.
